features.title: Millcreek buildings and canopy cover zones (2023 lidar), planning estimate
features.snippet: County building footprints with lidar roof heights, and canopy cover by ownership zone. Unvalidated LiDAR planning estimate from the 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (flown October-November 2023); not surveyed or field-verified data.
features.description:
Two layers. buildings: 22,042 county footprints with roof-height statistics from the October 22 consensus roofs (HEIGHT_P50_M, HEIGHT_P95_M and in feet; HEIGHT_STATUS flags low support). canopy_cover_zones: 13 ownership zones with canopy cover (canopy at least 2 m as a share of observed cells; city 25.59%).

Unvalidated LiDAR planning estimate from the 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (flown October-November 2023); not surveyed or field-verified data.

Coordinates: NAD83(2011) taken to WGS84 / Web Mercator with WGS_1984_(ITRF08)_To_NAD_1983_2011, the same as every layer in this set. Elevations NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres.

Records: canopy-toolbox/reviews/2026-10-22 in buschbrian/agol-python-scripts (branch canopy/classification-refinement). See hosting/feature-layers/README.md.
features.accessInformation: Millcreek GIS; lidar: 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 (USGS 3DEP).
features.licenseInfo: Unvalidated LiDAR planning estimate from the 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (flown October-November 2023); not surveyed or field-verified data.

slope.title: Millcreek slope classes 0.5 m (2023 lidar), planning estimate
slope.snippet: Slope in six classes (under 10%, 10-15, 15-20, 20-25, 25-30, 30% and over) from the 0.5 m lidar terrain, 4 m2 minimum mapping unit. Unvalidated LiDAR planning estimate from the 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (flown October-November 2023); not surveyed or field-verified data.
slope.description:
129,352 polygons from slope_percent (3 m neighbourhood). Patches under 4 m2 joined their largest neighbour; the areas steeper than each threshold hold within 0.54 points of the raw raster. No attributes in the tiles (legend from the style).
